git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(hooks): add round-3 coverage for push-guard hardening (beadle-fc6o)

Add 35 new cases exercising every confirmed gap from the round-3
review: the six global-option bypass forms plus their feature-branch
mirror, +main/+refs force-refspec denial, multi-line cd-then-push scope
resolution (both directions), composed -C chains, lexical-ambiguity
denial (subshell, || guard), CDPATH-clean stdout, and the dependency
fail-closed paths (grep absent, awk absent entirely, awk present but
exiting non-zero, non-JSON stdin, empty stdin).

Harden assert_decision to check exit status and exact stdout shape
(empty for allow, exactly one deny line for deny) instead of a
substring match, so a crashed hook can no longer be misread as an
allow. assert_fallback_decision now surfaces the hook's own stderr on
failure and checks exit status too. Replace the stale "TMPDIR
unwritable" probe, which exercised a mktemp-based stripper this hook no
longer has, with an explicit regression guard asserting the current
awk-via-process-substitution path has no such dependency.

81 cases, 0 failures.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <[redacted-email]>
EOF
)"
